agent.problem: The question begins with “They” without identifying the people of the land. The pronoun's antecedent is only on the preceding story card, which is no longer on screen, so the question does not supply its own context.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.
